name: Soybean Crush Spread
description: CBOT board crush spread: processing margin from converting soybeans into soybean oil and meal. Formula: 11 lbs × ZL/100 + 44 lbs × ZM/100 − ZS/100. Uses unadjusted futures prices to preserve true dollar margin levels. Shows crush margin over time with 1-year moving average, month-by-year seasonal heatmap highlighting March's position in the annual cycle, and extreme margin events.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread — CBOT Board Crush
# Formula: 11 lbs × ZL/100 + 44 lbs × ZM/100 − ZS/100
# All prices unadjusted to preserve true dollar margin levels

# --- Data ---
# Primary asset: soybeans (ZS) — the input commodity
src = market_data_source()()
zs = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# Reference: soybean oil (ZL) and soybean meal (ZM)
zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ---
# ZS: cents/bushel, ZM: $/short ton, ZL: cents/lb
# Board crush: 1 bushel soybeans (60 lbs) → 44 lbs meal + 11 lbs oil
# Revenue: 11 × ZL/100 (oil, convert cents to dollars) + 44 × ZM/100 (meal, $/ton → $/lb × 44)
# Note: ZM is $/short ton (2000 lbs), so 44 lbs meal = ZM × 44/2000 = ZM × 0.022
# Cost: ZS/100 (convert cents to dollars)
zl_close = ffill(zl.c)
zm_close = ffill(zm.c)
zs_close = zs.c

# Oil revenue: 11 lbs × (ZL cents/lb) / 100 = dollars
oil_revenue = 11.0 * zl_close / 100.0

# Meal revenue: ZM is $/short ton (2000 lbs), 44 lbs of meal
# 44 lbs / 2000 lbs per ton × ZM $/ton = ZM × 0.022
meal_revenue = zm_close * 44.0 / 2000.0

# Bean cost: ZS is cents/bushel, convert to dollars
bean_cost = zs_close / 100.0

# Crush spread (gross processing margin, $/bushel)
crush = oil_revenue + meal_revenue - bean_cost

# --- Trend & Context ---
crush_ma252 = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(crush)

# 1-year z-score for extreme detection
crush_zscore = zscore(window=252)(crush)

# 1-year high and low
crush_1y_high = max(period=252)(crush)
crush_1y_low = min(period=252)(crush)

# --- Seasonal Pattern ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# --- Event Detection: Extreme crush margins ---
# Flag when crush z-score exceeds ±2 (extreme margin events)
is_extreme_high = is_valid(crush_zscore) and crush_zscore > 2.0
is_extreme_low = is_valid(crush_zscore) and crush_zscore < -2.0
is_extreme = is_extreme_high or is_extreme_low
extreme_label = conditional_select(is_extreme_high, 1.0, is_extreme_low, -1.0, 0.0)
extreme_direction = where(is_extreme, extreme_label)

# --- Output 1: Crush Spread Over Time (CONTEXT) ---
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Margin — Where Are We?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='$/bushel',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='1Y Moving Avg', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush, crush_ma252))

# --- Output 2: Month × Year Heatmap (PUNCHLINE) ---
# Shows crush margin for every month of every year — March column reveals consistency
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)

heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Crush Margin by Month & Year — Is March Consistently High or Low?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Year',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    min_color=Color.Red,
    max_color=Color.Blue,
    show_data_labels=True,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.2f}',
    value_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    order=2
)(x=month_num, y=year_num, value=crush)

# --- Output 3: Summary Stats (REFERENCE) ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Crush Spread Key Statistics',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Current', 'Historical'],
        col_headers=['Crush ($/bu)', '1Y Z-Score', '1Y Range'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Latest crush spread value'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Current z-score vs trailing 1Y'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Trailing 1Y high'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='All-time median crush spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Median z-score (should be ~0)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Trailing 1Y low')
        ]
    ),
    category='Crush Spread',
    order=0
)(crush, crush_zscore, crush_1y_high, crush, crush_zscore, crush_1y_low)

# --- Event Markers: Extreme Crush Margin Events ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Extreme Crush Margin',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush Spread', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(crush, crush_zscore, extreme_direction, is_extreme)
